[[Ivor's Icon]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[focus item]] dropped by [[Ivor Helmhewer]], a [[boss]] in [[Sorrow's Furnace]].

==Stats==
:[[Energy]] +12 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]])
:[[Smiting Prayers]] +1 (20% chance while using [[skill]]s)
:Halves skill recharge of [[spell]]s (Chance: 10%)

==Skin== 
This item uses the same [[skin]] as the [[Divine Symbol]] (Chalice/Cup).

==Replica==
This item cannot be replicated for several reasons:
*It effectively has two [[inscription]]s, "Master of My Domain" and "Serenity Now".
*"Master of My Domain" would result in a 20% chance of +1 to Divine Favor, not Smiting Prayers.
